notes.title: Farewell from Team 1 & Last Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]This will be our final update for [i]Palette Cleanser[/i]. As of today, we are officially ending development and support for the game. The team is disbanding, and we’re all moving on to new adventures, some of us to other projects, others finishing up our studies, and a few just catching up on sleep.[/p][p]We want to thank every single one of you who played, shared feedback, or simply spent time in our little garden world. This game started as a student project, but your support made it feel like something much more.[/p][p]To wrap things up properly, we’ve released one last patch that fixes a handful of lingering bugs and adds some final polish. You can find the full patch notes below.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey.
– Team 1 

Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed delayed music after returning to main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ramp animation and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with ranged enemies assigned to sprinklers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed airdash spam when jumping on the ramp[/p][/*][*][p]Applied emissive materials to fans[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision on breakable walls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quitting issue when opening settings from the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where pressing jump after pausing reopened the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed settings menu requiring multiple clicks when accessed from pause[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed credits scene speed[/p][/*][/list][p]New [/p][list][*][p]Sprinkler animations[/p][/*][*][p]More desaturated objects [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes: [p][b]That’s right, the brushes are down, the paint’s dry, and [i]Palette Cleanser[/i] is officially released![/b][/p][p]After months of development, testing, and your incredible feedback during the demo and Next Fest, we’re thrilled to finally open the doors to the full experience![/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new in the full release?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Onboarding tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]Updated mechanics and smoother gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes, polish passes, and performance boosts[/p][/*][*][p]More color,  more animations, more fun[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support. This project couldn’t have come to life without your enthusiasm, feedback, and chaos.[/p][p]— Team 1[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409198/8d785e811708455c875211da3402a691307079e5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
